name: v14_seleval_smoke
purpose: TASKS 129 (16 Nov 2026, design note 13): the first real run of the selection eval that read1 will make unattended for 32 checkpoints — one finished stage-1 checkpoint (c00_control, seed 0) through `v14_search.py seleval --only`: the model-registry gate, the 161-of-169 id list, the evaluator's flags, the reproduction of the trainer's all-169 score within 0.001, the seconds and the peak memory. In WSL under probes/wsl_capped.sh so that the live training (v14_stage1, 7.7 GB) cannot lose memory to it: the kernel stops this run at the cap.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 5000 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(SEL) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_dev/bin/python probes/v14_search.py seleval --only c00_control"

estimate.basis: a hold-out eval of 80 molecules took 113 s (chain 41); this one reads about 249 molecules, and loads the corpus through /mnt/c — unmeasured on this path, which is what the run is for

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 5000 MB; the eval's own peak is unmeasured (the run prints its max RSS)
